newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle steady-up $0.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle steady-up $0.50 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $0.50 per cwt higher, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said.
Trade was slow to moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 70.00-71.00 few to 72.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs 71.00 few to 72.00.
On a carcass basis (weight only), compared to Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were steady to firm.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 112.25-113.00 west to 114.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales Holstein - (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 104.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 99.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs west 113.00-114.00.
